svg.title: Historical Policy Context
svg.desc: Brochure cites Hebei 2019 data: 2,305 plain-area geothermal wells, approximately 77% without compliant reinjection provision, alongside a 23.5% reinjection figure. It describes provincial support for heat extraction without net water withdrawal, simplified filing, subsidies, demonstrations and local standards. These are historical source statements; current local requirements and eligibility require confirmation.
